properties.name: 图书馆
properties.info: 香港科技大学（广州）图书馆致力成为：学习与研究的活力枢纽、启迪灵感的不竭源泉、知识交流与典藏传承的可靠伙伴。除丰富的馆藏资源与智慧化设施外,图书馆更承载多重角色,既是展览空间,也是文献档案馆,更是文化与科技融合中心。图书馆既凝聚校园归属感,亦营造赋能环境,让师生在此学习、创作、协作,并与新兴技术深度互动。
properties.info_en: HKUST(GZ) Library aspires to be a dynamic hub for learning and research, a source of inspiration, and a dependable partner for knowledge exchange and preservation. Beyond its extensive collections and smart facilities, the library assumes multiple roles — including those of a gallery, archive, and a center for culture and technology — which collectively cultivate a sense of belonging and create an enabling environment where our community learns, creates, collaborates, and engages with emerging technologies.

properties.name: 沉浸式工作室
properties.info: 沉浸式工作室搭载七台高清投影机，运用先进边缘融合技术，实现全域墙面的震撼影像投射。该空间融合人机交互与 AIGC 人工智能生成内容，打造沉浸式、可交互的多元体验。
properties.info_en: Immersive+ Studio is equipped with seven high-definition projectors that use advanced edge-blending technology to cast stunning images across the walls. By integrating human-computer interaction and AIGC (AI-Generated Content), this space delivers an immersive and interactive experience.

properties.name: 310 \n多媒体实验室
properties.info: 多媒体实验室配备苹果一体机与 Windows 台式计算机，预装常用应用软件及特色多媒体制作软件，面向全校师生开放使用。
properties.info_en: The Media Lab is equipped with Apple iMacs and Windows desktops, pre-installed with common applications and specialized multimedia production software, and is open to all faculty, staff and students.

properties.name: 311 \n金融终端实验室
properties.info: 金融终端实验室计算机搭载彭博（Bloomberg）、万得（Wind）等专业金融终端，面向全校师生开放使用。
properties.info_en: The Financial Data Lab open is equipped with professional terminals including Bloomberg and Wind. The lab is peon to all faculty, staff and students.

properties.name: 教工沙龙
properties.info: 教工沙龙是面向全校教职工打造的专属研修空间，内设书架墙、研讨桌、会议桌、休闲沙发等设施，可供教职工开展深度学习、小组研讨，举办专题研讨会、项目洽谈会，亦可供休闲交流。
properties.info_en: The Faculty Lounge is a dedicated research space for faculty and staff. Fitted with bookshelf walls, discussion tables, conference tables and casual sofas, it serves as a venue for in-depth study, group discussions, seminars, project negotiations and casual socialising.

properties.name: 视觉呈现实验室
properties.info: 视觉呈现实验室配备五面显示墙组成的洞穴式大屏系统，因而得名 “CAVE 屏幕”。屏幕总显示面积达 86 平方米，依托专业工作站级处理器驱动，可带来高度沉浸、逼真的视听体验，支持沉浸式裸眼 3D 影像展示。
properties.info_en: The Visualization Lab features a cave‑like large screen system with five display surfaces, hence the name “CAVE Screen”. It boasts a total display area of 86 m². Driven by professional workstation‑grade processors, it delivers highly immersive and lifelike audio‑visual experiences and supports the presentation of immersive naked‑eye 3D videos.
